corrections.text: The article places "rules only they can meet as a way to box out rivals" in quotation marks as Ferguson's caution. The Decoder does not quote Ferguson; the wording is The Decoder's own paraphrase of his remark that major AI companies shouldn't push for rules only they can meet as a way to box out rivals.

The article attributes the quote "Chairman Ferguson initiated an investigation into the leading AI firms a few weeks ago," the "investigative phase" characterization and the statement that the probe would not impede U.S. AI dominance to "the FTC". The Next Web reports these as remarks by an unnamed senior FTC official to the New York Post, not as on-record agency statements.
